name: Timing Assist
description: Holds your click for a few ms until the timing is safe, then lets it through. Works in every gamemode.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the timing assist on or off.

max-delay.name: Max Delay (ms)
max-delay.description: The longest a click can be held back while waiting for a safe tick. Higher saves more clicks but can feel floaty. 1 tick is about 4ms.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (ms)
lookahead.description: How far ahead it checks whether a click would kill you. Cube, ball and robot check until you land, so this is just the limit.

keep-hold.name: Keep Hold Length
keep-hold.description: If a press gets delayed, your release gets delayed by the same amount, so you still hold for as long as you meant to.

release-assist.name: Release Assist
release-assist.description: In ship, wave and robot, also checks your release and nudges it to the closest safe tick.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: If the mod moved any of your inputs during an attempt, that attempt won't save progress. Attempts where it never stepped in still count.

indicator.name: Show Adjustments
indicator.description: Shows a small label in the bottom left whenever an input gets moved. Takes effect next time you enter a level.

smart-predict.name: Smart Predict
smart-predict.description: Fixes clicks that came a little too late. If clicking now would kill you but clicking a moment ago wouldn't have, it rewinds your player those few ticks, applies the click there, then catches back up. Your icon can snap a tiny bit when this happens.

smart-window.name: Smart Predict Window (ms)
smart-window.description: How late a click can be and still get fixed. Bigger windows save more clicks but the snap gets more noticeable.
